entities.summary: Adriana da Cunha Calcanhotto is a Brazilian singer-songwriter. Her melancholic songs are often categorized in the MPB genre. She began her professional career in 1984 and released her first studio album in 1990. She is also a teacher and ambassador of the University of Coimbra in Portugal.
